notes: Document is a Los Angeles City Council motion (Council File 24-1031, presented by Councilmember Heather Hutt, Sep 3, 2024). It only instructs the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on how many entities use algorithm-based rent-setting software and whether a ban would be feasible. It does not propose or enact any operative rule, so no algorithmic_rent_setting record was extracted. The passing mention that the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved a ban in July 2024 is background news, not a statement of that law, and was not extracted. The OCR'd signature lines are garbled.
